postings.title: Senior Director, GTM Finance
postings.text:
About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Director of GTM Finance to lead the financial strategy and operating cadence across our go-to-market organization.

This leader will partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and GTM Operations to translate company growth objectives into actionable plans across bookings, pipeline, capacity, productivity, retention, investment, and profitability.

This is a highly visible leadership role for someone who combines strong financial judgment with deep SaaS and GTM operating experience. The right candidate will be equally comfortable advising executives, challenging assumptions, building rigorous financial models, and diving into the underlying data and processes when needed.

A critical part of the role is modernizing how GTM Finance operates. We expect this leader to embrace AI, automation, and advanced analytics to improve forecast accuracy, accelerate decision-making, strengthen controls, and reduce manual work.

The role will also have meaningful responsibility for sales compensation and commissions, including plan economics, forecasting, governance, administration, and partnership with Accounting and GTM leadership.

What You Will Own

• Lead Finance partnership for Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and other GTM functions, providing a clear financial point of view on performance, investments, tradeoffs, and growth opportunities.

• Own GTM planning and forecasting across bookings, ARR, pipeline, sales capacity, productivity, headcount, operating expenses, retention, and other key business drivers.

• Develop a deep understanding of GTM performance and proactively identify risks and opportunities before they become visible in reported results.

• Partner with Sales and GTM Operations on capacity planning, territory and quota assumptions, ramp, productivity, pipeline coverage, conversion, and resource allocation.

• Partner with Marketing leadership to evaluate demand generation performance, investment efficiency, pipeline creation, attribution, and allocation of resources across programs and channels.

• Support Customer Success and Renewals leadership with retention, churn, expansion, renewal economics, and capacity planning.

• Lead the financial strategy and governance for sales compensation plans, including plan design, modeling, quota economics, incentive alignment, and cost forecasting.

• Oversee commissions forecasting and administration in partnership with Accounting and Sales Compensation, with a strong focus on accuracy, controls, scalability, and clear ownership.

• Build executive-ready narratives that connect financial results with operational drivers and clearly articulate what happened, why it happened, and what actions should follow.

• Provide financial leadership on major GTM initiatives, including new products, geographic expansion, pricing and packaging changes, channel investments, productivity programs, and other growth initiatives.

• Build and continuously improve driver-based financial models that connect pipeline, capacity, productivity, conversion, retention, and investment assumptions to bookings, ARR, revenue, and profitability.

• Use AI, automation, and advanced analytics to improve forecasting, variance analysis, management reporting, scenario planning, and recurring Finance processes.

• Identify opportunities to eliminate manual workflows and build more scalable processes across planning, reporting, commissions, and business partnership activities.

• Establish clear metrics, operating cadences, and management reporting that enable GTM and Finance leaders to make faster and better decisions.

• Lead, develop, and raise the bar for the GTM Finance team, creating clear accountability while building strong relationships across Finance and the business.

What We Are Looking For

• 12+ years experience in FP&A, strategic finance, or a related discipline, including leadership experience in a high-growth SaaS or recurring revenue business.

• Deep understanding of SaaS and GTM economics, including ARR, bookings, pipeline, conversion, sales capacity, rep productivity, retention, and customer acquisition.

• Demonstrated experience owning or materially influencing GTM planning, forecasting, and resource allocation.

• Strong experience partnering directly with senior Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance executives.

• Meaningful experience with sales compensation strategy, plan modeling, quota economics, commissions forecasting, or commissions administration.

• Strong command of operating expense and headcount management, with the ability to connect investments to business outcomes.

• Exceptional analytical skills and the ability to move comfortably between detailed operating analysis and executive-level strategic discussions.

• Strong financial modeling skills and experience building driver-based forecasts and scenarios in complex, rapidly changing environments.

• Ability to translate large amounts of financial and operational data into concise insights, recommendations, and actions.

• Demonstrated ability to improve processes, systems, controls, and operating discipline rather than simply manage existing workflows.

• Strong interest in AI and automation, with practical experience using modern tools to improve Finance productivity, analysis, or decision support.

• High ownership mindset. Comfortable personally driving important work while also building a team that can operate independently at scale.

• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field. MBA, CPA, or equivalent advanced experience is a plus.

Nice to Have

• Experience in cybersecurity, enterprise software, or another complex B2B SaaS environment.

• Experience with modern planning, BI, CRM, commissions, and data platforms.

• Experience applying machine learning, data science, or AI techniques to forecasting, pipeline analytics, or financial planning.

• Experience supporting new product launches, multi product expansion, international expansion, channel strategy, or multi-product GTM models.

postings.title: Senior Manager, Corporate Finance
postings.text:
About the Role

Corporate FP&A sits at the center of Abnormal AI's financial engine, turning granular financial data into the forecasts, board materials, and executive insight that drive decisions across the company. As Senior Manager, Corporate Finance, you'll own the annual operating plan, forecast cadence, and monthly CFO reporting package, and serve as the connective tissue between FP&A, Accounting, and senior leadership — translating complex financial dynamics into clear, decision-ready narratives. You'll manage and grow a small team of corporate finance analysts, and be a driving force in modernizing how the team plans, reports, and operates, with a strong bias toward AI-native workflows. This role also plays a meaningful part in Abnormal's public-company readiness work. You'll thrive here if you move fluidly between granular financial detail and executive-level synthesis, and if you like building structure rather than inheriting it.

What You'll Do

• Own the annual plan and forecast cadence across the P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow — with particular ownership of revenue and free cash flow forecasting — using driver-based models to continuously improve accuracy.

• Build scenario and sensitivity modeling into a core FP&A capability that informs key leadership decisions.

• Oversee the team’s ownership of the monthly CFO review package — budget vs actual variance analysis, forecast, and supporting analytics — partnering with Accounting on the close, while staying hands-on in building Board and investor reporting materials.

• Turn financial and operating data into clear, actionable insight for leadership through recurring reporting, dashboards, and ad hoc analysis.

• Oversee the team's ownership of Pigment systems, and direct AI-enabled automation and process/controls improvement across FP&A.

• Support SOX controls, audit committee materials, and other IPO-readiness work, partnering with Legal, Accounting, Investor Relations, and the CFO's office.

• Partner with Accounting, Tax, and People on specialized, cross-functional forecast items such as equity, payroll taxes, and benefits.

• Manage and grow a team of corporate finance analysts/managers, including coaching and career development.

Must Haves

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field; MBA or CPA a plus.

• 6-9+ years of progressive FP&A or corporate finance experience, ideally within high-growth SaaS or cybersecurity, including experience managing or developing direct reports.

• Demonstrated track record of improving forecast accuracy and building driver-based financial models from scratch.

• Highly analytical, with strong fluency in modern FP&A systems (Pigment, Snowflake, or similar) — comfortable using data to independently uncover key insights.

• Strong command of the three financial statements and core SaaS operating metrics (e.g., gross margin, ARR, contribution margin).

• Direct experience supporting public-company readiness workstreams (e.g., SOX controls, audit committee/board materials).

• Proven ability to move fluidly between granular financial detail and executive-level synthesis, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• High affinity for AI tools, with a track record of leading automation or efficiency initiatives within FP&A.

Nice to Have

• Experience at a company through an actual IPO, or in its first year as a newly public company.

• Familiarity with NetSuite, Maxio, Workday, or Sigma.

• Experience with AI-assisted forecasting/reporting tools or agentic workflows (e.g., Claude, Pigment AI Analyst).

• Prior experience in investment banking, strategy consulting, or equity research.

• Cybersecurity or infrastructure software industry background.

postings.title: Senior Revenue Accountant
postings.text:
About the Role

Abnormal AI is looking for a Senior Revenue Accountant to join our Accounting team, reporting to Crystal He. In this role, you will own key areas of the revenue close process, preparing and reviewing audit-ready reconciliations, workpapers, journal entries, and analyses that support monthly close, financial reporting, and external audit requirements. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced accountant to gain meaningful ownership and exposure to technical revenue accounting in a high-growth SaaS environment, while partnering closely with experienced revenue and technical accounting professionals. The ideal candidate operates independently, exercises strong judgment, and is motivated to strengthen how revenue accounting operates by standardizing processes, enhancing controls, and leveraging automation and AI-enabled workflows to improve efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.

What You Will Do

• Own the preparation and review of monthly revenue-related reconciliations, rollforwards, and supporting schedules

• Prepare and review journal entries and flux analyses for revenue, deferred revenue, accounts receivable, commissions, and other related accounts

• Maintain complete, audit-ready documentation for recurring close activities, including organized workpapers, reconciliations, and supporting evidence

• Lead assigned revenue close deliverables, ensuring work is completed accurately, timely, and in accordance with established policies and controls

• Investigate and resolve accounting issues, unusual items, and reconciling differences in partnership with cross-functional stakeholders

• Support external audits by preparing support, coordinating requests, responding to inquiries, and documenting accounting positions

• Partner with Deal Desk, FP&A, Legal, and other teams to resolve operational issues and improve upstream process quality

• Identify and drive opportunities to streamline close activities through standardization, automation, and AI-enabled workflows

Must Haves

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field

• 4+ years of progressive accounting, audit, or related finance experience

• Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP, with experience applying revenue recognition guidance and related accounting principles

• Demonstrated experience owning or leading recurring close activities, reconciliations, and financial analyses in a fast-paced environment

• Strong analytical skills with excellent attention to detail, and the ability to identify issues, evaluate root causes, and implement solutions with limited oversight

• Advanced Excel skills, including reconciliations, lookups, and analysis of large datasets

Nice to Have

• Experience applying ASC 606 and ASC 340-40 in a SaaS revenue accounting environment

• Experience at a Big Four public accounting firm, a high-growth pre-IPO company, or a publicly traded technology company

• Experience with ERP, billing, and close-management systems such as NetSuite, Salesforce, Maxio, or FloQast

• CPA license (or active progress toward CPA) and interest in leveraging AI and automation to improve accounting processes
